messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Assalam o Alaikum Abu ji, main Bilal bol raha hoon aap ka beta.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Beta kahan se call kar rahe ho? Awaz change lag rahi hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Mere paas naya number hai purana kho gaya. Abu main Dubai airport phansa hoon, visa issue hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Mujhe 80,000 rupay urgent bhejne hain agent ko, warna jail ho jaye gi. Please kisi ko na batana, ammi ko mat batana.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Allah ke kasam sach keh rahe ho beta?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Abu main sach mein phansa hoon, foran bhejo is number par. Baad mein sab samjhata hoon.
